faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and tooling cost for FS-141 Twin-Bar 5-Crystal Dual-Tower-Spring Mechanical Stick EDC?
faqs.answer: Because FS-141 utilizes our mature ready-to-use production mold (#141), the tooling and mold fee is $0.00. The wholesale MOQ is 50 pcs for blank stock orders and 100 pcs for custom 50W Fiber Laser Engraved or Deep Laser + Color Fill logo orders.

faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-141?
faqs.answer: Yes. Note that our factory does NOT recommend surface silk-screen or UV ink printing on metal because smooth, chemically inert metal surfaces lack ink adhesion and peel off under thumb friction. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-141: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.

faqs.question: How are the magnets and hardware secured inside FS-141 for US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 compliance?
faqs.answer: All magnetic and mechanical assemblies (Non-Magnetic (Pure Mechanical / Bearing Action); 5 pcs Blue Crystal Inlay Ø4*1, 2 pcs Hardened Steel Detent Ball Ø5, 2 pcs Conical Compression Spring Wire ØØ0.4*Ø5.*Ø4*3.5, 4 pcs Countersunk Screw Ø5*1.5M2.5*3.5Hex Machine Screw , 1 pcs Countersunk Screw Ø4.15M2.5*5Phillips Machine Screw) are structurally enclosed or mechanically locked using industrial two-part structural epoxy (>22 MPa shear strength) and thread-locked fasteners, passing 10× 1.5m concrete drop abuse tests under US CPSC 16 CFR Part 1262 and EU RoHS 3 / REACH directives.
